x: Peter George is out in Canada doing his R.A.F. training. He says that he is enjoying the life and the country, and had a quick glance at New York on the way.
Peter George is, we understand, still in Canada undergoing his air training. Jimmy Kemp is climbing the ladder of promotion and is now acting sergeant.

Bedford, a new member, ran well in the 880 Yards race to finish second, and he also gained third place in the 1 Mile, in which Frank Close, the International runner, made a re-appearance to gain second place. Peter George turned out for us in the 440, and A.
